definitions.explanation: Pain in the stomach area. Can refer to both physical stomach pain and, figuratively, stress-induced discomfort.

examples.japanese: {胃痛|いつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胃痛|いつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a stomachache from stress.

examples.japanese: {胃痛|いつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ようなら⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: If the stomach pain continues, you should go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal/medical than ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ (my stomach hurts). Also used figuratively in internet slang to describe emotional stress caused by watching something cringe-worthy or anxiety-inducing (e.g., {胃痛|いつう}⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧ — an anime that causes stomach-churning anxiety).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃痛|いつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a stomachache)
- {胃痛|いつう}{薬|やく}/{胃痛|いつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (stomach pain medicine)
- ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{胃痛|いつう} (stress-induced stomach pain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧: abdominal pain — broader, includes intestinal pain
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my stomach hurts — casual/spoken equivalent
